transcript:
# Lowell City Council

## Non-Profit Organizations SC Meeting Minutes

Date: October 20, 2026

Time: 5:30 PM

Location: City Council Chamber, Lowell City Hall, Lowell, Ma. / Zoom (Hybrid)

## PRESENT:

Present on Roll Call were Chairman Liang, C. McDonough and C. Mercier.

## MEETING CALLED TO ORDER:

Chairman Liang called the meeting noting agenda items regarding federal grant funding for non-profits and further noted that Community Teamwork would not be providing a presentation today.

## ORDER OF BUSINESS:

C. Liang noted meetings are scheduled for all non-profits to participate whether they are large of small.

C. Liang opened matter up to public. Betsy Toro (Lowell Caribbean Festival) requested information to assist with fund raising for the festival. Ms. Toro noted that they are relatively new and need to be award of the system and how to contact City for assistance. Ms. Toro noted there current fundraising methods but stressed the need for further assistance. Maria Claudio (Roberto Clemente League) (via translation from Ms. Toro) described their organization noting it was a non-profit which helped young people stay out of trouble. Ms. Claudio noted the need for assistance with fundraising and that other entities who were to provide funds failed to do so. C. Liang questioned structure of the organization. Ms. Claudio indicated that they had a fiscal agent who was not performing appropriately. C. Mercier noted that if there is an issue with stealing the police would help, not a subcommittee. C. McDonough noted a subcommittee is not part of law enforcement. C. McDonough noted that all non-profits, big and small, should be part of the process. Carmen Bermudez (Hope Dove, Inc.) (via translation from Ms. Toro) described her entity, noting she was a pastor in Lowell for over thirty-two years. Ms. Bermudez noted upcoming toy event for children in need and that there is an existing food pantry she operates. Ms. Bermudez noted the constant challenge in raising funds. C. Mercier requested that the non-profits keep reaching out to the City for assistance and provide needed information to them. C. Liang noted subcommittee will reach out to all non-profits to held assist with their needs.

## ADJOURNMENT:

**Motion** to adjourn by C. Mercier, seconded by C. McDonough. So Voted.

Meeting adjourned at 5:55 PM

Michael Q. Geary, City Clerk
